items: 7–10 cups Special K or Corn Flakes

steps.title: Boil the syrup
steps.body: Bring to a boil in a pan on the stove, then take off heat immediately: **1 cup sugar** and **1 cup white corn syrup**.

steps.title: Add the cereal
steps.body: Then mix in **7–10 cups Special K or Corn Flakes**.

steps.title: Melt the chips
steps.body: Melt together **6 oz chocolate chips** and **6 oz butterscotch chips**.

steps.title: Top and cool
steps.body: Spread on top of cereal mixture. Let cool.

steps.title: Cut and serve
steps.body: Cut into desired sizes and serve.
